guard.note: local player, Pre: recasts / cooldowns / cast duration, then level.getEntities(null, box grown by 64, Player || IMagicEntity) (the wrapped call) and forEach(the loop lambda)
the loop: getSyncedSpellData; FIRE spin while spin-attacking -> burning dash particles; casting siphon / recall / raise hell -> their particles; nothing else
the predicate: instanceof Player || instanceof IMagicEntity
Player: the synced map (getOrDefault, the shared empty data); IMagicEntity: its magic data; any other entity: a new default (not casting, spin RIPTIDE)
the default: isCasting false, spinAttackType RIPTIDE
this(id) plus the entity: the same defaults
getEntities: the profiler's getEntities count, the section walk into a new list, NeoForge's part pass (parts in the box passing the predicate)
onTrackingStart: an AbstractClientPlayer joins level.players(); multipart parts into partEntities
onTrackingEnd: the player leaves level.players(); parts out of partEntities
addEntity: lookup, section, then onCreated and onTrackingStart for every entity
onRemove: out of the section, then onTrackingEnd
get(box, consumer): hands the walk to EntitySectionStorage.getEntities(box, ...)
getEntities(box, consumer): every accessible section of the box, section.getEntities(box, consumer)
getEntities(box, consumer): lists an entity only when its bounding box intersects the box (the gate tests only those players)
